notes.title: Game released!
notes.content:
[b]The final version of the game Dungeon of Dark was released now![/b] Moving out from early access!
And during the first week, the game is [b]discounted[/b].

A video for the Dungeon of Dark with gameplay.
[previewyoutube=0PuR2sO2rcQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 25 November release of the game
notes.content:
A lot of work has been done, and the game has become bigger and more RPG.
[b]The game is leaving early access.[/b] And it's time to announce the release date. The game will be released on[b] November 25th[/b].

The game got a story.  
[b]Were added: [/b]
Story quests.
New heroes, 
More abilities.
New dungeon inhabitants
New NPC. 
More dialogues and events appeared.
etc.
[previewyoutube=NlCFr8CzCf4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
New game patch. 
Patch 1.4.
-Variable battlefield. Battlefield not only 3*3 cells now. Variable shape from 2*2 to 4*4 cells.
-Blood Mage. New hero with his abilities.
-Were fixed small bugs and done small improvements.
